credibility_scale.medium: reputable trade/financial press or cross-confirmed secondary reporting
credibility_scale.low: single-source, model-derived, or politically exposed reporting requiring verification

_meta.mw_note: MW fields are intentionally split so non-binding awards, programme ambitions and power availability do not inflate live IT-load capacity.
release_notes: August 26 current baseline adds MIS x HUMAIN 250 MW letter of award as 0 MW live and +200 MW incremental announced scope until a binding contract and energisation evidence exist.
Saudi live denominator is shown as contested: MCIT-linked 467 MW headline versus Alvarez & Marsal ~410 MW / ~40 facilities.
UAE split separates national ~510 MW live from Khazna ~300 MW operational, ~370 MW under construction/commissioning and the 5 GW Stargate masterplan.
Qatar split separates Syntys/Ooredoo live capacity, MEEZA live/financed build-out and targets.
Excludes outbound/non-GCC capacity from Gulf live totals: Ooredoo/Zankore Indonesia, Mubadala/Akita Japan, Khazna x Eni Italy, Core42 Buffalo and DataVolt Uzbekistan.
_meta.disclaimer: Research intelligence only; capacity estimates remain provisional where primary energisation, contract or operator data is unavailable.
_meta.archive_note: Frozen Aug 26 package snapshot matching the current dashboard baseline at publication time.

analyst_notes.title: Separate capacity from power and ambition
analyst_notes.body: The Aug 26 baseline uses mw_it_live, mw_announced, power_gw_available and energisation_evidence to avoid adding letters of award, programme targets or utility availability to live IT load.

analyst_notes.title: Saudi ambition outpaces live denominator clarity
analyst_notes.body: Saudi has the largest ambition stack, but the live denominator is contested and several major items remain pre-FID or non-binding.

analyst_notes.title: UAE execution proof is strongest at operator level
analyst_notes.body: Khazna's split of operational versus construction/commissioning capacity is more investable than unsplit national masterplan totals.

analyst_notes.title: Resilience risk is now a dashboard variable
